name: ai.nerdnoir/nerdy
title: Nerdy by Nerd/Noir
description: A field manual for product and engineering leaders. Search it, or build its nine frameworks.

tools.name: search_collection
tools.description: Semantic search across the collection, the same engine as the chat on nerdnoir.ai. Returns the closest notes with slug, title, a short excerpt, and the page URL, best first. Optional filters narrow by frontmatter. For a signed-in reader with workshop access, results can include slides from those workshop decks (kind "slide"). Read a note in full with get_note. For Nerd/Noir's judgment on the reader's own situation, use lil_nerdy_ask_question instead.

query.description: What to look for, in plain words.

filters.description: Frontmatter filters. All of them must match.

op.description: eq/neq: scalar frontmatter equality. in: scalar is in a list. has: an array field (such as tags) contains the value. link_eq: a frontmatter wikilink resolves to the given slug.

key.description: Frontmatter field: type, framework, source, tags, authors, and so on.

value.description: A string, or a list of strings for `in`.

tools.name: get_note
tools.description: Retrieve the full markdown body of a single note by its slug (e.g. "concepts/teaming/team-topologies"). Every published note is public.

tools.name: list_by_tag
tools.description: List every published note that carries a tag, with its slug, title, category, and excerpt. Use it to gather the notes on one theme when a note from search_collection or get_note shows a tag worth following, for example "team-topologies". The match ignores case.

tools.name: list_by_category
tools.description: Return all published notes in a given top-level category. Common categories: concepts, tools, resources, case-studies, sources, workshops.

tools.name: list_backlinks
tools.description: Return the set of notes that wikilink to the given slug. Useful for discovering related content and upstream references.

tools.name: tools_list_documents
tools.description: Return the tool documents the signed-in user owns or shares through a Space, most recently edited first, with each one's id, tool, version, role, Space, and url (the page that opens it in its builder). Pass toolKey to list one builder's documents. Every other document tool needs one of these ids.

toolKey.description: Which builder: ost | usm | cfd | vsm | noice | wardley | roi | roadmap | framing.

tools.name: tools_get_document
tools.description: Return a document: its toolKey, title, version, url (the page that opens it in its builder), the current state as a projection with real ids, and the commands that tool takes, each with its fields. Read this before you change anything, then write with tools_apply_commands: pass its toolKey, and its version as expectedVersion.

tools.name: tools_get_history
tools.description: Return the most recent events on a document, newest first, each with its event id and a plain description. Use an event id with a RestoreTo command to put the document back to the state right after that event.

tools.name: tools_export_document
tools.description: Export a document as a file. format "json" (the default) returns the snapshot the builder's Download JSON writes: the saved state, which the Scenarios Upload button imports as a new document, a summary, and the canonical entities (outcomes, with their kind, metrics, and bets) in one vocabulary across tools. format "markdown" returns the document as markdown.

tools.name: tools_create_document
tools.description: Create a new, empty document for the signed-in user in one of the builders. Returns the new id and version. Pass spaceId to start it inside a shared Space the user can edit; without it the document is personal. Pass idempotencyKey and a repeat of the same call returns the document it already made rather than a second one. Give the reader the returned url: it opens the document in its builder.

toolKey.description: Which builder: ost | usm | cfd | vsm | noice | wardley | roi | roadmap | framing.

title.description: Defaults to the builder's own default.

idempotencyKey.description: Your id for this create. Repeating it returns the same document instead of making two.

spaceId.description: A shared Space to start the document in. The user must be its owner or an editor.

tools.name: tools_apply_commands
tools.description: Change one document in any builder: roadmap (Outcome-Based Roadmap), roi (ROI Calculator), noice (NOICE Prioritization), ost (Opportunity Solution Tree), usm (User Story Map), vsm (Value Stream Map), cfd (Cumulative Flow Diagram), wardley (Wardley Map), framing (Framing). Apply up to 25 commands as one atomic batch: all apply or none do. Read the document with tools_get_document first. It returns the toolKey to pass here, the version to pass as expectedVersion, and the commands that builder takes, each with its fields. A later command may name an entity an earlier one created only if you supplied no ids; read the result for the ids it assigned. StartOver clears a document, and RestoreTo with an event id from tools_get_history puts it back to that point. Send the same batchId again to retry safely after a timeout.

expectedVersion.description: The version you last read from tools_get_document. A stale version returns a conflict with what changed.

batchId.description: Your id for this batch. Repeating it returns the stored result instead of writing twice.

commands.description: Commands from the document's catalog in tools_get_document: each one is its type plus that command's fields.

tools.name: spaces_list_spaces
tools.description: Return the user's Spaces with each one's id, kind (private, shared, or cohort: the Space of a workshop cohort the user is in), the user's role (owner, editor, or viewer), and how many notes, documents, and members it holds. Private comes first and belongs to the user alone.

tools.name: spaces_get_space
tools.description: Return one Space with its notes in order, its documents (each with the url that opens it in its builder), and its members with their roles. Private lists the documents the user keeps outside every Space. A cohort Space also lists its people: the cohort's members, by name.

tools.name: spaces_create_space
tools.description: Make a shared Space owned by the user, optionally with its first notes in order. Names are unique per owner.

description.description: One sentence on what the Space is for.

slugs.description: Notes to start with, in order.

items.description: A page slug from search_collection or get_note, for example "concepts/teaming/team-topologies".

tools.name: spaces_share_document
tools.description: Put a document in a Space so everyone in it can open it. Editors and the owner can change it; viewers read it. Name an existing spaceId, or newSpaceName to make one. Only the document owner may do this, and only into a Space where they are owner or editor. A document is in one Space at most, so this moves it.

documentId.description: The document id, from tools_list_documents. Any builder's document.

newSpaceName.description: Make a Space with this name instead.

tools.name: spaces_unshare_document
tools.description: Take a document out of its Space, so it is personal to its owner again. Only the document owner may do this; the Space itself is left alone.

documentId.description: The document id, from tools_list_documents. Any builder's document.

tools.name: spaces_transfer_document
tools.description: Make another member of the document's Space the owner of the document. Use it when the reader asks to hand a document over, for example before they leave the Space. Only the current owner may do this, and the new owner must hold a role on the Space; a cohort reader does not count. Get the member's userId from spaces_get_space.

documentId.description: The document id, from tools_list_documents. Any builder's document.

tools.name: spaces_invite_members
tools.description: Add up to 20 people to a Space with one role: editor (adds and changes things) or viewer (reads). Any email address works. Somebody with no account gets an invite email; somebody with one joins at once. Needs the owner or editor role. Returns one answer per address.

documentId.description: Open this document for an invited person after they sign in.

tools.name: spaces_remove_member
tools.description: Remove a member from a Space. Owner only. The person's documents in the Space pass to the Space owner, so nothing leaves the Space.

tools.name: spaces_leave_space
tools.description: Take the signed-in user out of a Space. Their documents in it pass to the Space owner. The owner cannot leave; they hand the Space over or delete it.

tools.name: spaces_add_note
tools.description: Add a published page to the end of a Space. Needs the owner or editor role. Adding a page that is there already changes nothing.

slug.description: A page slug from search_collection or get_note, for example "concepts/teaming/team-topologies".

tools.name: spaces_remove_note
tools.description: Take a page out of a Space's list. The page stays published, and the Space keeps its other pages and documents. Use it when the reader asks to drop a page from a Space; spaces_get_space lists the slugs in it. Needs the owner or editor role.

slug.description: A page slug from search_collection or get_note, for example "concepts/teaming/team-topologies".

tools.name: spaces_list_outcomes
tools.description: Return every outcome that the frames, roadmaps, NOICE rankings, and Opportunity Solution Trees of a Space hold, one row per outcome. Each row lists the documents that hold it, with the outcome id in that document and what that builder says about it (a roadmap column and status, a NOICE rank, the progress of a frame goal). A row with a linkId is one outcome by a stored link. A row without one groups outcomes only because their titles are the same. Each row also lists the story maps, ROI calculations, and Wardley maps attached to the outcome; a story map that holds the stories for one roadmap bet names the bet. `suggestions` lists pairs of rows with different titles that share words and are not linked: they may be one outcome, so ask the reader before you link them. The result also lines up the workflow stages and the people that the documents name, by name only. Use it to find an outcome that one document holds and another does not, and for the ids that spaces_link_outcomes and spaces_copy_outcome take.

tools.name: spaces_link_outcomes
tools.description: Say that outcomes in different documents of one Space are one outcome. The link changes no text in any document: it keeps the outcomes in one row when a title changes. Use it when the reader asks to link outcomes, or names two that are the same. An outcome that is in a link already brings the rest of that link with it. Needs the owner or editor role.

documentId.description: The document that holds the outcome.

entityId.description: The outcome id inside that document, from spaces_list_outcomes.

tools.name: spaces_attach_to_outcome
tools.description: Put a story map, an ROI calculation, or a Wardley map of a Space with one outcome of that Space. With `bet` (the id or the label of a bet of a roadmap outcome), put a story map with that bet instead: it holds the stories for the bet. A document goes with one outcome or one bet at most, so a second call moves it. No document changes: the link is the only write. Needs the owner or editor role.

documentId.description: The story map, the ROI calculation, or the Wardley map.
The document that holds the outcome.

entityId.description: The outcome id inside that document, from spaces_list_outcomes.

bet.description: A bet of that roadmap outcome, by id or by label. Only for a story map.

tools.name: spaces_unlink_outcome
tools.description: Remove one outcome from the link it is in. The outcome and its document stay as they are. A link left with one outcome is removed too. Use it when the reader says two linked outcomes are not the same. Needs the owner or editor role.

documentId.description: The document that holds the outcome.

entityId.description: The outcome id inside that document, from spaces_list_outcomes.

tools.name: spaces_copy_outcome
tools.description: Put an outcome that one document holds into another document of the same Space, and link the two. Use it to add a roadmap outcome to a NOICE ranking, a frame goal to the roadmap, and the like. Give toDocumentId for a document of the Space, or newToolKey to start a new document for the outcome. A target that already holds an outcome with that title is linked and not written. A tree holds one outcome, so a tree that has one refuses a second. For any other change to a document, use tools_apply_commands. Needs the owner or editor role.

documentId.description: The document that holds the outcome.

entityId.description: The outcome id inside that document, from spaces_list_outcomes.

toDocumentId.description: The document to put the outcome in. It must be in the Space.

newToolKey.description: Start a new document of this builder. Use it only without toDocumentId.

column.description: The column, when the target is a roadmap. Later when absent.

tools.name: lil_nerdy_ask_question
tools.description: Ask Lil Nerdy, Nerd/Noir's own assistant, and get its answer with the collection pages it drew on. Use it when the user asks for Lil Nerdy, or for Nerd/Noir's judgment on their situation; for a plain lookup, search the collection yourself. It knows the reader's saved memories, and for a reader with workshop access it can cite that workshop's slides. Each call is a new conversation: pass only the earlier turns with Lil Nerdy that the question depends on, as history. Pass document_id to ask about one of their builder documents; with edit allowed, it can change that document. Each call counts against the reader's chat allowance on nerdnoir.ai and can take 20 to 60 seconds.

question.description: The question, in the user’s words.

page.description: A collection slug the question is about, for example "concepts/teaming/conways-law".

document_id.description: One of the user’s builder documents, from tools_list_documents.

history.description: Earlier turns of this thread with Lil Nerdy, oldest first, at most 10.
